question: Does the interaction-secondary HARM structure survive a Riemannian MDM decoder on the SPD manifold?
rank_handling: CAR19 leaves a null direction. Project onto a fixed orthonormal basis of the 18-dim complement of the all-ones vector, THEN add ridge once.
ridge_rule: eps_fold = 1e-06 * mean(trace(C_train)/18), clean training runs only
metric: AIRM for both centroid (Karcher mean) and distance

clean_validity_gate_frozen_before_contam.rule: subject enters the primary median only if clean MDM OOF accuracy >= 0.6
clean_validity_gate_frozen_before_contam.rationale: fixes the Stage 6 defect where subjects near chance dominated the count

primary_reporting: 9 subject values, median, 95% subject-level bootstrap interval
thresholds: NOT copied from CSP Stage 5/6; reporting is continuous
data_scope: 0train only; 247 development donors; artifact subjects 12/14/17/19/23/25 excluded
